svg.title: QPUTwin system architecture
svg.desc: A numpy-free FastAPI control plane admits OpenQASM jobs, queues asynchronous ones under leases in a shared SQLite store and dispatches them over HTTP to a data plane of four worker services; each worker parses, routes, compiles, schedules, applies the calibrated noise model and simulates with the fused engine of one QPU twin.
svg.text: CONTROL PLANE · ORCHESTRATOR ×N · FASTAPI, NO NUMPY
DATA PLANE · WORKER PER QPU · FASTAPI + NUMPY
